reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a compositional hierarchy: the ContextPacket ingests game state, feeds it through the Router to select active equations, which then drive the JEV Simulator and Copula Engine to generate realistic trajectories. The key mathematical challenge is balancing expressiveness (21,419 equations) with computational tractability (~33ms budget). Sinkhorn-Knopp ensures non-negativity and row/column sums while the Student-t noise introduces heavy tails consistent with sports data. The 10,000-world ensemble provides robust uncertainty quantification for downstream fantasy optimization. Dualities emerge between routing decisions and equation weighting schemes, both of which can be interpreted as Bayesian model averaging under different priors. Failure modes include overfitting in the router (large equation count) and structural misspecification if the elliptical copula cannot capture true dependencies.
